name: courtsync
description: CourtSync - multi-tenant sports facility and court management platform

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w functions && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w functions && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:rules && npm run test:flows
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:start --project demo-courtsync --import ./emulator-data --export-on-exit ./emulator-data
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build && firebase deploy --project dev
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && firebase deploy --project staging
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && firebase deploy --project prod
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage --project demo-courtsync "vitest run --project emulator tests/emulator/rules.test.ts"
scripts.test:flows: npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage,functions --project demo-courtsync "vitest run --project emulator tests/emulator/flows.test.ts"
